The architecture document needs to specify required capacity as 40,000 events per second. I haven't updated the doc yet because it came up during a separate task. Critically, this changes the service comparison: NimbusMQ throttles at 25,000 events per second, while StreamForge supports 40,000. The staging test only hit 20,000 on both, which is why neither showed errors — but NimbusMQ would fail under the real production burst requirement.
